messages.content:
[1] אי = "if" (suggested form אי)
  1. אִי II (from the word) — = אִין; h. אִם; cmp. אוֹ); if, whether; adv. of interrogation, v. אִין II
  2. אִי־ — prefix, v. אִ־
  3. א (via אִי־) — Aleph, the first letter of the alphabet, interchanging with other gutturals, e.g. אבב, הבב, חבב, עבב; אליתא, ע
  4. א ² (via אִי־) — often used to form second roots of verbs ע"ע, e.g. אטם, טמם
  5. א ³ (via אִי־) — frequ. prosthetic, e.g. אגודל, גודל, v. אִ־
  6. א ⁴ (via אִי־) — sometimes inserted to replace a radical, as באגא = בגא, esp. in verbs ע"ו, as דָּאִיךְ fr. דּוּךְ, קָאִים fr. 
  7. א ⁵ (via אִי־) — frequ. (in Talm. Y.) dropped in the beginning of words, e.g. בָּא = אַבָּא; מַר = אֲמַר
  8. א ⁶ (via אִי־) — affixed to the end of Chald. nouns, corresponding to prefixed ה in Hebrew (status emphaticus), e.g. אַבָּא = ה
  9. אִ־ (via אִי־) — &c. a prefix; for the formation of nouns in Kal, Peel, Afel (Hifil) &c., e.g. אִסְפְּקָא, אִיסְ׳, אַפְטָרָה, אַפְטַרְתָּא &c; demonstrative, e.g. אִיהוּ = h. הַהוּא; אִנָּא, אִינָא &c; euphonic (prosthetic) אִדְמָא = דְּמָא; אִית = h. יֵשׁ &c., esp. before foreign words beginning with two conso
  10. אַ־ (via אִי־) — a prefix (followed by Dagesh Forte) = עַל upon, over, e.g. אַמָּרָא = עַל מָרָא; even before gutturals, e.g. א
  11. אִי I (from the word) — fem. of אוּ q. v
  12. אִי III (from the word) — = h. אֵין) not. Git. IV

[2] דבלאו = "without him (if not for him)" (suggested form בלאו)
  1. לַאו (from the word) — v. לַאי) no, not
  2. לֵאוּ (from the word) — v. ליאוּ
  3. לֵיאוּ (via לֵאוּ) — לְאִי, לְעִי); labor; earning, acquired property

[3] איהו = "he" (suggested form איהו)
  1. אִיהוּ (from the word) — אִיהִי f. (= הוּ, הִי, v. אִ־) he, himself; she, herself

[4] לא = "would not" (suggested form לא)
  1. לֹא (from the word) — v. לַאי) not, no
  2. לָא I (from the word) — (no English given)
  3. לָא II (from the word) — preced. wds.) particle, mote. Yoma
  4. חַרְגָּא (via לָא II) — constr. חַרְגַּת (חרג, v. P. Sm
  5. חִרְגָּא (via לָא II) — v. preced.) [saw-dust,] sun-motes (cmp. נָסַר). Yoma
  6. לָא III (from the word) — La, abbrev. of אִילָא, הִילָא; v. Fr. M’bo, p

[5] אזלא = "would spread (go)" (suggested form אזל)
  1. אֲזַל I — to be gone, to leave; to go
  2. אֲזַל II — = עזל; v. Ezek. XXVII
  3. זוּל I (via אֲזַל II) — v. זָלַל) to be of slight value, to be cheap; to be despicable, mean; low, mean; spendthrift, glutton. Sifré; Hif. to become cheap, fall in price; Hif. to treat with contempt. Treat. Der. Er. ch. II מְזִילֵי הרבים those who treat the public &c; Hof. to fall in price
  4. זוּל (via אֲזַל II) — perf. זָל, Part. זִיל, זוֹל; to disregard; to be worthless, cheap; Af. to sell cheap, make easy terms; Ithpe. to be degraded, disgraced
  5. זוּל II (via אֲזַל II) — cmp. אֲזַל II) to spin
  6. זוֹל (via אֲזַל II) — זוּל I) low price
  7. אַזְלוֹיָא (via אֲזַל II) — foreg.) weaver. Pl. אַזְלוֹיֵי

[6] פשיטא = "it is obvious" (suggested form פשיט)
  1. פְּשִׁיטָא (from the word) — c. (preced.); explanation, teaching.—Pl. פְּשִׁיטִין; plain, self-evident truth; is it not a matter of course?; fem.) Ps’hiṭa, a small coin
  2. פְּשַׁט — to stretch, stretch forth; to straighten; to strip, tear, flay; neut. verb) to be stretched forth, reach out; to explain, teach; to deduce
  3. פְּשֵׁיט — v. פְּשַׁט
  4. פָּשַׁט (via פְּשֵׁיט) — b. h.); to stretch, straighten; to strip; (sub. בגדיו) to undress. Yoma III; to make plain, to explain; neut. verb) to spread, be published; Pi. to stretch, straighten out; Pi. to strip, take off; Nif. to be straightened out, be unfolded, become flat; Nif. to be stripped. Pirké d’; Hif. to strip, flay; Hif. to shed the

[7] אלא = "rather" (suggested form אלא)
  1. אֶלָּא (from the word) — contr. of אִן לָא = אִם לֹא); if not, except, but, only; ellipt.) (you cannot say anything except …) but, a logical inference excluding all other explanations &c
  2. אֵלָא (from the word) — buttress, v. אֵילָא
  3. אֵילָא (via אֵלָא) — trnsf. beak of a ship (a beam to which the head of a ram was attached), prow; projection from a lateral wall, buttress, &c; cmp. אַיִּל
  4. אַיָּלָא (via אֵלָא) — (no English given)
  5. אִילָא (via אֵלָא) — Ila; a Tannai; an Amora. Yoma
  6. אִילָּא (via אֵלָא) — v. אֶלָּא
  7. אֲלָא I (from the word) — to lament, v. אלי
  8. אלי I (via אֲלָא I) — to curse. Sifré
  9. אלי II (via אֲלָא I) — = ילל, v. אִילְיָא) to lament, wail; Pa. same
  10. אֱלִי (via אֲלָא I) — mourning, v. אַלְיָתָא and אַלִּיתָא
  11. אֲלָא II (from the word) — club, bat
  12. אַלָּתָא (via אֲלָא II) — = h. אַלָּה) post, pole, door-post

[8] דבלאו = "without him" (suggested form בלאו)
  1. לַאו (from the word) — v. לַאי) no, not
  2. לֵאוּ (from the word) — v. ליאוּ
  3. לֵיאוּ (via לֵאוּ) — לְאִי, לְעִי); labor; earning, acquired property

[9] אזלא = "would have spread (go)" (suggested form אזל)
  1. אֲזַל I — to be gone, to leave; to go
  2. אֲזַל II — = עזל; v. Ezek. XXVII
  3. זוּל I (via אֲזַל II) — v. זָלַל) to be of slight value, to be cheap; to be despicable, mean; low, mean; spendthrift, glutton. Sifré; Hif. to become cheap, fall in price; Hif. to treat with contempt. Treat. Der. Er. ch. II מְזִילֵי הרבים those who treat the public &c; Hof. to fall in price
  4. זוּל (via אֲזַל II) — perf. זָל, Part. זִיל, זוֹל; to disregard; to be worthless, cheap; Af. to sell cheap, make easy terms; Ithpe. to be degraded, disgraced
  5. זוּל II (via אֲזַל II) — cmp. אֲזַל II) to spin
  6. זוֹל (via אֲזַל II) — זוּל I) low price
  7. אַזְלוֹיָא (via אֲזַל II) — foreg.) weaver. Pl. אַזְלוֹיֵי

[10] מאי = "what" (suggested form מאי)
  1. מַאי (from the word) — = מא הי) what?; why?
  2. אִי־ — prefix, v. אִ־
  3. א (via אִי־) — Aleph, the first letter of the alphabet, interchanging with other gutturals, e.g. אבב, הבב, חבב, עבב; אליתא, ע
  4. א ² (via אִי־) — often used to form second roots of verbs ע"ע, e.g. אטם, טמם
  5. א ³ (via אִי־) — frequ. prosthetic, e.g. אגודל, גודל, v. אִ־
  6. א ⁴ (via אִי־) — sometimes inserted to replace a radical, as באגא = בגא, esp. in verbs ע"ו, as דָּאִיךְ fr. דּוּךְ, קָאִים fr. 
  7. א ⁵ (via אִי־) — frequ. (in Talm. Y.) dropped in the beginning of words, e.g. בָּא = אַבָּא; מַר = אֲמַר
  8. א ⁶ (via אִי־) — affixed to the end of Chald. nouns, corresponding to prefixed ה in Hebrew (status emphaticus), e.g. אַבָּא = ה
  9. אִ־ (via אִי־) — &c. a prefix; for the formation of nouns in Kal, Peel, Afel (Hifil) &c., e.g. אִסְפְּקָא, אִיסְ׳, אַפְטָרָה, אַפְטַרְתָּא &c; demonstrative, e.g. אִיהוּ = h. הַהוּא; אִנָּא, אִינָא &c; euphonic (prosthetic) אִדְמָא = דְּמָא; אִית = h. יֵשׁ &c., esp. before foreign words beginning with two conso
  10. אַ־ (via אִי־) — a prefix (followed by Dagesh Forte) = עַל upon, over, e.g. אַמָּרָא = עַל מָרָא; even before gutturals, e.g. א
  11. אִי I (from the word) — fem. of אוּ q. v
  12. אִי II (from the word) — = אִין; h. אִם; cmp. אוֹ); if, whether; adv. of interrogation, v. אִין II

[11] קא = "(present progressive marker)" (suggested form קא)
  1. קָא (from the word) — abbrev. of קאם, v. קָאֵים a. קוּם) [he, it stands,] a particle of emphasis, mostly untranslatable

[12] עביד = "did" (suggested form עבד)
  1. עֲבַד I (from the word) — corresp. to h. עָשָׂה); to do, labor; to make; to act; to do, fare, prosper; to spend time; Pa. to make, produce; Pa. to cause to prosper; Pa. to work through. Part. pass. מְעַבַּד, מְעַבְּדָא; Ithpe. to be done; to be made, become
  2. עֲבִיד (from the word) — v. עֲבַד I, II
  3. עָבַד (via עֲבִיד) — b. h.) [to work; to serve, work for; to prepare; to till the ground; to dress (hides); v. עֲבוֹדָה) to use esp. for idolatrous purposes; to worship; Nif. to be prepared, dressed; Nif. to be used, esp. for illicit purposes; to be worshipped; Nithpa. same, v. supra; Hif. to enslave, oppress; Pi. to prepare, esp. to dress
  4. עֶבֶד (via עֲבִיד) — preced. wds.) slave, servant
  5. עֲבַד (via עֲבִיד) — same; worshipper

[13] מתקיף = "objects" (suggested form תקף)
  1. תְּקַף (from the word) — to seize, hold firmly; to be strong, become powerful; to be heavy, rest heavily upon, be hard; with רוגזא, or sub. רוגזא) to be vehement, hot, excited; Pa. cmp. חזק); Pa. to strengthen; to repair; to harden (the heart of); Pa. to seize, force; Pa. v. תַּקִּיף) to be strong &c., v. supra; Af. to grow strong; Af. to stre
  2. תְּקֵיף (from the word) — v. תְּקֵף
  3. תָּקַף (via תְּקֵיף) — to seize, overpower; with על) to rest heavily upon, be hard
  4. תֹּקֶף (via תְּקֵיף) — v. תּוֹקֶף, תּוּקְפָא
  5. תַּקִּיף (from the word) — strong, powerful. Sifré
  6. תַּקִּיף ² (from the word) — strong, mighty; protector; hard, stern, severe
  7. תּוֹקֶף — strength, power

[14] רב = "Rav" (suggested form רב)
  1. רַב I (from the word) — large, great; much
  2. רַב II (from the word) — preced.); superior, master; teacher
  3. רַב (from the word) — large, great, numerous; senior; chief, master, teacher

[15] פפא = "Pappa" (suggested form פפא)
  1. פַּפָּא (from the word) — tradit. pronunc. פָּפָּא) pr. n. m. Pappa (Papa), name of several Amoraim
  2. דּוּן (via פַּפָּא) — v. דִּין
  3. דְּוָן (via פַּפָּא) — v. דְּוָון
  4. פַּפָּא II (from the word) — N’har Pappa, name of a canal and of a place in Babylonia

[16] והא = "but surely" (suggested form הא)
  1. הָא I (from the word) — demonstr. pronoun) this. Yoma
  2. הָא II (from the word) — v. preced.) an interjection; cmp. הָ־) Oh!; behold(h; introducing a question, is it that?
  3. הֵא II (from the word) — He-He
  4. הִא III (from the word) — name of a worm, v. הֵה
  5. הָהּ (via הִא III) — interj.) ah, alas!
  6. הֵה (via הִא III) — heh, name of a worm in the pomegranate

[17] איכא = "there is" (suggested form איכא)
  1. אִיכָּא (from the word) — contr. of אִית־כָּא); there is, there are (sunt qui). א׳ דאמרי (abbrev. א"ד.) some say; he who
  2. אֵיכָא (from the word) — = אֵי a. כָּא) where now? (ubinam)
  3. אֵיכַן (via אֵיכָא) — אֵי־כַּאַן, v. אֵיכָא) where? also relat. where, &c

[18] הא = "that" (suggested form הא)
  1. הָא I (from the word) — demonstr. pronoun) this. Yoma
  2. הָא II (from the word) — v. preced.) an interjection; cmp. הָ־) Oh!; behold(h; introducing a question, is it that?
  3. הֵא II (from the word) — He-He
  4. הִא III (from the word) — name of a worm, v. הֵה
  5. הָהּ (via הִא III) — interj.) ah, alas!
  6. הֵה (via הִא III) — heh, name of a worm in the pomegranate

[19] דתניא = "which was taught" (suggested form תנא)
  1. תְּנֵי — to repeat, do a second time; to tell, relate; to teach; Pa. to change; Pa. to tell, relate; to teach; Af. to stipulate, agree, make a condition; Af. to relate, teach; Ithpe. to be repeated; Ithpe. to be told, reported
  2. תְּנָא — v. תְּנֵי
  3. תני (via תְּנָא) — v. שָׁנָה) [to repeat,] to tell; Pi. same; Hif. to stipulate, agree, make a condition
  4. תְּנֵי II (via תְּנָא) — cmp. שנן) to be pointed, sharp; Pa. to sharpen, to speak sharp words; Ithpe. to be sharpened
  5. תַּנָּא — preced.) teacher, esp. Tanna, an authority quoted in Mishnah and Boraitha, contrad. to אֲמוֹרָא

[20] שישבו = "who sat" (suggested form יתב)
  1. יתֵב — to sit, dwell &c.; to be inhabited, settled; Pa. to set down, place; Pa. to settle, establish; Pa. to quiet, set at rest; Af. to place, seat, settle (v. יָשַׁבHif.); Ithpe. אִיתִּיב; Ittaf. אִיתּוֹתַב; Ithpe. to be allowed to dwell, to sojourn (h. גּוּר); Ithpe. to be inhabited; Ithpe. to be set at ease, be gratified
  2. יְתֵב II — v. preced.; cmp. יהב to give and to place) to give (not used in perf. tense)
  3. יָתֵב — יְתַב I) inhabitant

[21] על = "on" (suggested form על)
  1. עֹל (from the word) — v. עוֹל
  2. עוֹל (via עֹל) — imperat. of עֲלַל
  3. עוּל (via עֹל) — interch. with עֲלַל); to come, come in. Perf. עָל, עָאל; part. עָל, עָאֵיל, עָאֵל, עָיֵיל; to bring in; Pa. to come in habitually. Inf. מְעַיֵּיל, v. מֵעֲלָא; Pa. to bring in, insert; Pa. to produce, develop, ripen; Ithpa. to insert one’s self; to get in. Yoma; Af. Ittaf. אִיתָּעַל, Ithpe. אִתְעַל, v. עֲלַל
  4. עוֹל ² (via עֹל) — yoke; also pole of a wagon
  5. עָוַל (via עֹל) — b. h.), Pi. עִוֵּול, עִיוֵּל (denom. of עָוֶל) to act perversely; to do wrong, cheat
  6. עָוֶל (via עֹל) — perversion, fault
  7. עַל (from the word) — height; (prepos.) upon, above; about &c.—With suff. (pl.) עָלַי, עָלֶיךָ &c
  8. עַל ² (from the word) — (no English given)
  9. טוּף (via עַל ²) — to shine,] to come to the surface, float, bubble up. Part. טָאֵיף, טָיֵיף; denom. of טיף) to drip; to be inundated; Pa. to direct the overflow, to assign channels; Pa. to cause to glisten, to turn in all directions; Pa. to cause to float, v. infra; Af. fr. נְטַף); Af. to make flow; Af. to cause to float; Ithpa. to be g
  10. עָל (from the word) — verb, v. עוּל, עֲלַל
  11. *עָל (from the word) — cmp. עִילָא II) plan
  12. עֵל (from the word) — v. עֵיל

[22] ספסל = "bench" (suggested form ספסל)
  1. סַפְסָל (from the word) — v. סֵפֶל; frame, bench, stool

[23] אחד = "one" (suggested form אחד)
  1. אֶחָד (from the word) — אַחַת f. (b. h.; v. next w., one. [Freq. represented by א׳; singular, unique; cmp. אֲחַד) closed up, mysterious
  2. אָחַד (from the word) — sec. r. of חוּד, v. חוּד I) to join, close. Part. pass. אָחוּד, pl. אֲחוּדִים; closed up, mysterious; joined, united
  3. אֲחַד (from the word) — Pa. אָחֵיד, אַחֵד ch. (v. foreg.); corresp. to h. סגר a. תפש; cmp. h. אחז) to close (the door), to lock up; to seize, capture; to devote, v. אֲחִיד; Af. to seize; Ithpe. to be seized; Ithpe. to be locked up, joined

[24] ולא = "and it did not" (suggested form לא)
  1. וָלָא (from the word) — v. וָאלִי; P. Sm
  2. וָאלִי (via וָלָא) — ואל, cmp. b. h. יָעַל a. הוֹאִיל) propriety. לא ו׳ it is unbecoming
  3. לֹא (from the word) — v. לַאי) not, no
  4. לָא I (from the word) — (no English given)
  5. לָא II (from the word) — preced. wds.) particle, mote. Yoma
  6. חַרְגָּא (via לָא II) — constr. חַרְגַּת (חרג, v. P. Sm
  7. חִרְגָּא (via לָא II) — v. preced.) [saw-dust,] sun-motes (cmp. נָסַר). Yoma
  8. לָא III (from the word) — La, abbrev. of אִילָא, הִילָא; v. Fr. M’bo, p

[25] שברוהו = "break it" (suggested form שבר)
  1. שֵׂבֶר — v. סֵבֶר
  2. סְבַר (via שֵׂבֶר) — with אַפִּין) to show a bright face, be pleasant; to favor (with ב or ל); to be bright, intelligent; to look out for, hope; to speculate, plan; to imagine, believe; to conclude, argue, understand; to have an idea; Pa. to look for, hope, trust; Pa. with אַפִּין) to favor; Af. to trust; Af. to make confident; Af. with אַ
  3. סָבַר (via שֵׂבֶר) — Pi.; Saf. of ברר) [to be bright,] to look for, be hopeful; to think, imagine. Part. pass. סָבוּר; f. סְבוּרָה;; Hif. to brighten, illustrate, make clear
  4. סְבַר II (via שֵׂבֶר) — Poël סוֹבַר (cmp. סבל) [to encompass,] to carry; to bear, endure; to sustain
